notes: Relevant sets are the files a developer would need to read or modify to complete the task, written by hand BEFORE any ranking change was made and without looking at ranker output.

Files that a task would create (and that do not exist yet) cannot be listed; where a task is normally done by editing an existing registry, template or caller, those existing files are the relevant ones.

Each task has a split. 'dev' tasks were used while developing ranking changes. 'holdout' tasks were not inspected per-task during development; only their aggregate metrics were looked at, and only to confirm that dev improvements generalise.
Labels are one person's judgement and the sets are small; treat differences of a few points as noise.

Disclosure: the first baseline run printed the per-task table for ALL tasks, so the holdout failures of the baseline ranker were seen once before any change was made. Holdout is therefore not perfectly blind. Afterwards the runner hides holdout per-task rows (--show-holdout reveals them) and ranking changes were designed from dev failures and general principles only.
